crossRefs.note: Furthermore Yahweh was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should…
but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.
but the land that you go over to possess is a land of hills and valleys which drinks water from the rain of the sky,
a land which Yahweh your God cares for. Yahweh your God’s eyes are always on it, from the beginning of the year even to…
I have come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land to a good and…
They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring…
in that day I swore to them, to bring them out of the land of Egypt into a land that I had searched out for them…

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Lebanon
people.line: A mountainous region known for its cedar trees

translations.web: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”
translations.bsb: Please let me cross over and see the good land beyond the Jordan—that pleasant hill country as well as Lebanon!”
translations.kjv: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
translations.asv: Let me go over, I pray thee, and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
